rawText: Debrief from Sarah Connor (sarah.c@ecomvelocity.com, tel: +1-206-555-0142). The candidate demonstrated deep CSS layout understanding and detailed knowledge of React state reconciliation. The interviewer liked how cleanly you articulated component boundary patterns. On the other hand, the panel was concerned that you lacked concrete performance metrics on web vital improvements, speaking only in abstract terms when pressed for specific millisecond targets. Additionally, you rambled when asked about micro-frontend trade-offs and did not state a decisive conclusion. For career details, visit https://careers.ecomvelocity.com/faq.

strengths.evidence: detailed knowledge of React state reconciliation

weaknesses.evidence: lacked concrete performance metrics on web vital improvements
weaknesses.requestedFix: Quote specific LCP/INP millisecond targets and optimization techniques

weaknesses.evidence: rambled when asked about micro-frontend trade-offs
weaknesses.requestedFix: Start with a direct trade-off summary before analyzing module federation

mockExtraction.overallTone: Mixed; positive on fundamentals but failed on senior communication
mockExtraction.uncertainty: Testing methodologies were not explicitly probed during this round
